title: Directed Graph Facade for NetworkX Parity
description: Implement DirectedGraph, the NetworkX DiGraph parity facade, in mathematical/graph/normal/directed/rs/lib.rs, wrapping mathematical_graph::Storage<Normal, Directed>. Covers construction, node/edge ops, directed queries (successors/predecessors/in_edges/out_edges/degrees/density), transforms (copy/subgraph/edge_subgraph/reverse/to_undirected/clear), attribute helpers, self-loop helpers, path helpers, and directed-only helpers (all_neighbors). Implements GraphView/AttrView/EdgeWeights by delegation. Single file owned exclusively for this ticket; only mathematical_graph (+ optionally mathematical_random/mathematical_algebra) used as deps — no re-exports of empty stub crates.
